channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Moraes rejeita revisar pena de Débora do Batom, condenada pelo 8/1
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes rejected a request by Débora do Batom's defense to immediately reduce her sentence under the Dosimetria Bill, stating the bill has not yet been promulgated. Débora, sentenced to 14 years for participating in the January 8, 2023, coup attempts and graffitiing 'Perdeu, mané' on the statue of Justice with lipstick, is currently serving house arrest in Paulínia, SP, under electronic monitoring. Moraes emphasized that although Congress overturned the presidential veto on April 30, 2026, the law is not in force until officially promulgated.

item.title: 30 anos da urna: TSE promove ações interativas para aproximar jovens do processo eleitoral
item.description: Students from four schools in the Federal District participated in interactive activities at the TSE to celebrate the 30th anniversary of the electronic ballot box. The actions included voting simulations, quizzes, the 'Path of the Vote' exhibition, and the launch of the mascot Pilili, aiming to educate youth about the electoral process and combat misinformation.

item.title: Moraes nega pedido de ‘Débora do Batom’ para reduzir pena após PL da Dosimetria: ‘não está em vigor’
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes denied a request by the defense of Débora Rodrigues dos Santos, known as 'Débora do Batom', to reduce her sentence based on the Dosimetria Bill, as the law has not yet taken effect. The bill, which allows for sentence reductions for crimes against democracy, had its presidential veto overturned by Congress but awaits promulgation by President Lula. Débora was sentenced to 14 years in prison for her role in the January 8, 2023, anti-democratic attacks.

item.title: As idas e vindas de Lula e Trump: tarifaço, 'química excelente' e Ramagem
item.description: Lula and Trump are scheduled to meet on May 7 at the White House, after a March meeting was postponed due to the U.S.-Iran war. Their relationship has been marked by fluctuating dynamics — including mutual praise, three phone calls, and an in-person meeting in Malaysia in October 2025 — but also by tensions such as Trump’s 40% 'tariff barrage' on Brazilian goods in July 2025 and sanctions against Brazilian Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Urna eletrônica é aberta para estudantes no evento dos 30 anos do equipamento
item.description: TSE Electoral Technology Coordinator Rafael Azevedo opened an electronic voting machine during the 30th-anniversary event for students, explaining its internal components and emphasizing that, while it is simple to open (with three screws), it is extremely complex to fraud due to embedded hardware and software security mechanisms. He stressed that the machine operates offline, ballot secrecy is maintained even when open, and that in 30 years, there has been no evidence of fraud in Brazil’s electronic voting system.

item.title: Flávio e Malafaia selam paz após desentendimentos no início do ano
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro attended a service at Pastor Silas Malafaia’s church, ending months of public disagreements between the two. The gesture signals an effort to unify the conservative base ahead of the 2026 elections, as both seek to align forces in the national political landscape.

item.title: Federação PT, PCdoB e PV processa PL por impulsionamento indevido de propaganda antecipada negativa contra Lula
item.description: The Brazil Hope Federation (PT-PCdoB-PV) filed five representations against the PL at the TSE for alleged improper boosting of negative pre-campaign propaganda against President Lula. The actions were filed yesterday and concern subscriber-only content, with full access requiring registration. The case involves electoral dispute and campaign regulation in the context of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Eleição suplementar para governador de Roraima acontecerá no dia 21 de junho
item.description: The Electoral Justice of Roraima has called a supplementary gubernatorial election for June 21, following the TSE's cassation of Governor Edilson Damião (União). The resolution was published on Sunday, June 3. The election will determine who will serve the remainder of the current term.

item.title: Literatura fantástica de um Moraes associado a Alcolumbre e Bolsonaro é obra-prima de Lula
item.description: The text presents a conspiracy theory without evidence, claiming that Alexandre de Moraes allegedly allied with Davi Alcolumbre and Flávio Bolsonaro to block investigations into alleged 'voracious traffics' and protect the Supreme Court from impeachment processes, all attributed to a supposed maneuver by Lula to distance himself from Moraes. This version is described as 'fantasy literature,' devoid of concrete facts and based on political speculation aimed at portraying Lula as a victim of an anti-system scheme.

item.title: Páginas pró-governo publicam versão de 'Dona Maria' para defender Lula nas redes
item.description: Left-wing profiles supporting Lula created a pro-government version of the fictional AI character 'Dona Maria', originally used by the right to criticize the government, adapting it to defend the president and attack the Bolsonaro family. The strategy imitates the right's viral tactic, using AI to generate emotionally charged, high-engagement content on social media. The PT, PV, and PCdoB parties filed a complaint with the TSE to suspend the dissemination of the original character's content.

item.title: Conheça a Pilili, mascote símbolo das eleições 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unveiled 'Pilili' as the official mascot for the 2026 elections on Monday, May 4, 2026. Inspired by the sound of the 'confirm' button on electronic voting machines, Pilili symbolizes accessibility, trust, and democratic protection. The launch coincided with the 30th anniversary of Brazil's electronic voting system, attended by TSE President Minister Cármen Lúcia.

item.title: ‘Ninguém viu?’: o questionamento indireto de Dino sobre o Caso Master
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino indirectly questioned the Master Bank, comparing it to a 'blue-painted elephant' that no one notices despite its obvious absurdity, when commenting on the issuance of CDBs with yields of up to 140% of the CDI backed by precatory credits. He asked how no one had seen such irregularities, emphasizing his long public service career since 1999. Gilmar Mendes also attended the hearing, criticizing the myopia of focusing solely on the STF to address the crisis of trust in institutions.

item.title: Moraes rejeita mudar dosimetria da pena de Débora do Batom
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes denied a request to reduce the sentence of Débora do Batom, stating that although the Dosimetry Law had its veto overturned by Congress, it has not yet been promulgated or published and therefore is not in force. Débora, a hairdresser convicted for her participation in the January 8 acts, is serving time under house arrest for crimes including coup d'état, violent abolition of the democratic rule of law, and qualified damage to public property. The veto override benefits 849 convicted individuals, including former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: TSE celebra 30 anos da urna eletrônica e lança mascote para atrair eleitor jovem
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) celebrated the 30th anniversary of the electronic voting machine with the launch of its mascot, Pilili, designed to attract young voters, particularly those with optional voting. The event took place on Monday, November 4, as part of a broader strategy to boost civic engagement among younger generations.

item.title: Lula socorre endividados para tirar popularidade do vermelho
item.description: The launch of Desenrola 2, the Brazilian government's debt renegotiation program under President Lula, offers interest rates below 2% for approximately 32 million people with overdue debts, according to Datafolha showing 67% of voters have some form of financial debt. The initiative is described as one of the last electoral measures before the 2026 elections, aimed at boosting the president's popularity.

item.title: Saiba quem é 'Pilili', mascote das Eleições de 2026 lançada pelo TSE; veja vídeo
item.description: The TSE unveiled 'Pilili' as the official mascot for the 2026 Brazilian elections — an anthropomorphized electronic ballot box symbolizing neutrality and democracy. The genderless character will travel across Brazil to encourage voter participation, especially among youth, through animations, tutorials, and educational materials. Named after the sound the ballot box makes when confirming a vote, Pilili’s launch coincided with the 30th anniversary of Brazil’s electronic voting system.

item.title: Código Penal ganha penas mais duras para furto e golpe digital
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed Law 15.397/2026, which increases penalties for theft and digital fraud, marking one of the most comprehensive revisions of the Brazilian Penal Code in recent years. The bill originated as PL 3.780/2023, proposed by Deputy Kim Kataguiri (Missão-SP), and was approved by the Senate in March under the rapporteurship of Senator Efraim.

item.title: TSE lança mascote Pilili e celebra 30 anos da urna eletrônica
item.description: The TSE celebrated the 30th anniversary of the electronic voting machine with the launch of its mascot, Pilili, designed to engage the public, especially youth. President Minister Cármen Lúcia emphasized the system's security, reliability, and auditability, stating that votes are computed individually without external interference. She also urged students aged 15–17 who will turn 16 by October 4 to register and exercise their right to vote.

item.title: Crusoé: TSE lança mascote ‘Pilili’ para as eleições
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unveiled the official mascot for the 2026 elections, named 'Pilili', inspired by the sound of electronic voting machines. The court described the character as a 'defender of democracy', accessible and easy to engage with, without a defined gender. The initiative aims to bring voters closer to the electoral process in a playful and inclusive manner.

item.title: Áudio: Eleitores têm até 6 de maio para tirar ou regularizar título
item.description: The deadline to obtain a first-time voter ID, update registration data, renew biometrics, or transfer electoral domicile ends on May 6. While most services can be completed online via the TSE website, issuing a first title or making changes requiring biometrics requires in-person attendance at an Electoral Justice unit.

item.title: Quem é Pilili? É a mascote das Eleições 2026
item.description: Pilili is the mascot for Brazil's 2026 elections, inspired by the electronic voting machine. Created in 2023 by the TSE's Coweb team, it represents neutrality, democracy, and conscious voting, with no defined gender. It communicates through gestures, subtitles, and speech bubbles, symbolizing the accessibility and impartiality of the electoral system.

item.title: Urna eletrônica acabou com fraudes nas eleições, diz Cármen Lúcia
item.description: TSE President Minister Cármen Lúcia stated that electronic voting machines have eliminated the possibility of fraud in Brazilian elections during a 30-year anniversary event for the equipment. She explained that the system replaced paper ballots and manual counting, which were vulnerable to fraud such as voting on behalf of others and altered results. The TSE also launched the mascot Pilili to encourage youth voter participation in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Lula lança programa para salvar endividados que ele mesmo criou
item.description: The federal government launched a new phase of the Desenrola Brasil program to reduce household debt and facilitate credit access, allowing renegotiation of debts overdue by at least 90 days with discounts up to 90% and interest rates of 1.99% per month. The initiative covers debts incurred until January 2026 and aims to alleviate financial strain on families. While framed as a solution to the debt crisis, critics argue that much of the debt stems from the government's own economic policies.

item.title: Quem quer trabalhar no Brasil tem que engolir a CLT, diz Zema
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) argued that Brazilians should have the freedom to choose their work schedule, criticizing the mandatory CLT and proposing a parallel regime allowing employer-employee agreements on hours. He compared the CLT to marriage, stating that just as one can choose a property regime, workers should be able to opt for 30, 40, or 50-hour workweeks. Zema also supported ending the 6x1 work scale, claiming economic measures must improve income and that the CLT, nearly 90 years old, is outdated globally.

item.title: Lula terá encontro com Trump nos EUA; Alckmin vê peso estratégico na reunião
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin said the upcoming meeting between Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and U.S. President Donald Trump in Washington carries strategic weight for bilateral relations and Brazil’s economic agenda. Lula’s trip is scheduled for next Thursday, April 7.

item.title: Com presença incerta de Lula, PT faz hoje jantar de arrecadação
item.description: The PT held a fundraising dinner in Brasília with tickets ranging from R$1,000 to R$50,000, despite the uncertain presence of President Lula, who sent a video message for the opening of the party’s 8th Congress. In the video, Lula stressed that electoral strategy should focus on showcasing concrete government results and urged activists to prioritize direct voter contact over social media.

item.title: Zema rebate Erika Hilton sobre escala 6×1: “Vive de mentira”
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate of the Novo party, rebuked federal deputy Erika Hilton (Psol-SP) for claiming that the right proposes that 14-year-old children stop studying to work under a 6x1 schedule, calling the statement a lie. Zema argued that the right seeks to improve education quality and combat child labor, not encourage it.

item.title: Grupo aciona MP contra Malafaia por propaganda eleitoral em culto
item.description: The secular association Movimento Brasil Laico filed a complaint with the Regional Electoral Prosecutor’s Office in Rio de Janeiro against pastor Silas Malafaia, the ADVEC church, and six politicians, including Flávio Bolsonaro, for alleged early electioneering during a religious service. The group claims the event constituted religious power abuse and requests eight years of ineligibility and R$25,000 fines for each defendant. Defendants, such as federal deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante, argue their participation was protected religious expression without explicit campaigning.

item.title: Motta deve procurar Alcolumbre para alinhar texto de consenso da PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta plans to meet with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to align the text of the PEC ending the 6×1 work scale and prevent major changes in the Senate. The goal is to secure approval by July, treating the measure as a Lula government priority, following the recent Senate rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination, which reflected senatorial dissatisfaction with the Planalto.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula quer usar “boa química” com Trump na campanha
item.description: President Lula will travel to the United States for a meeting with Donald Trump on Thursday, the 7th, aiming to boost his electoral polling numbers, inspired by the positive reaction he received after meeting the former U.S. president in Malaysia last October. The strategy seeks to leverage the perceived 'good chemistry' between the two leaders to strengthen Lula's 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: Rejeição a Messias indica fim da Ordem Constitucional de 1988 no Brasil
item.description: The Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court, backed by Flávio Bolsonaro and Davi Alcolumbre, marks the end of Brazil's 1988 constitutional order and the rise of a 'New Old Republic' where senators dominate both the Executive and Judiciary. This shift empowers Bolsonarist factions, with the Senate poised to negotiate STF minister impeachments from 2027 onward, leaving Lula's government politically isolated and weakened in legislative bargaining.

item.title: O que diz Geraldo Alckmin sobre o encontro entre Lula e Trump nos Estados Unidos
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin expressed his hope that the meeting between President Lula and Donald Trump in the United States would take place in a spirit of good chemistry, benefiting the bilateral relations between Brazil and the U.S. Despite Lula's recent criticisms of Trump, Alckmin emphasized the importance of strengthening dialogue between the two major democracies.

item.title: Flávio convoca jovens de 16 anos a tirar título de eleitor
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the 2026 Brazilian presidency, called on teenagers turning 16 to obtain their voter registration by next Wednesday, the 6th, to broaden his electoral base. In a video posted on X, he stated that the 2026 elections will be decisive for the country’s future. The call is part of his pre-campaign strategy to attract young voters.

item.title: 10 anos depois, um novo golpe parlamentar
item.description: Ten years after the impeachment of Dilma Rousseff, new signs point to a possible parliamentary coup in Brazil, with articulations between conservative sectors of Congress and the Judiciary aiming to undermine progressive governments. The author, Josué Medeiros, warns that the strategy combines selective use of denunciations, media pressure, and procedural maneuvers to subvert the popular will expressed at the ballot box.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei que endurece penas para crimes de furto, roubo e receptação; saiba o que mudou
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed Law 15.397/2026, increasing penalties for theft, robbery, receiving stolen goods, fraud, and digital crimes, including new offenses like receiving stolen domestic animals and providing 'dummy' bank accounts for money laundering. The law also toughens penalties for crimes against essential services such as energy and telecommunications, and raises the minimum sentence for latrocínio from 20 to 24 years.

item.title: Lula se irrita com pecha de traíra colocada em aliado e decide manter Jaques Wagner na liderança no governo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva decided to keep Jaques Wagner as the government leader in the Senate, despite the historic rejection of Jorge Messias to the STF and accusations that Wagner had betrayed the government by aligning with Davi Alcolumbre. Lula expressed irritation with allies who accused Wagner but retained him due to their over 40-year friendship and trust. Wagner, who was in China on an official trip, had misjudged the vote outcome, but Lula rejected calls for his removal.

item.title: Alckmin lamenta derrota de Messias e diz que Lula já avalia nova indicação ao STF
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin lamented the defeat of Jorge Messias in the STF vote, praising his qualifications and warning about the negative impact of the vacant seat on an already overburdened court. He said President Lula is already evaluating a new nomination and denied any crisis with Senator Davi Alcolumbre, emphasizing the president's dialogic approach.

item.title: Lula sanciona aumento de pena para os crimes de furto, roubo e receptação
item.description: President Lula signed a law increasing penalties for theft, robbery, and receiving stolen goods, with maximum sentences rising to 10 years for theft and 24 years for latrocínio. The law includes enhanced penalties for electronic crimes, animal trafficking, and 'orange account' lending, and doubles punishment for using electronic devices or internet applications in bank fraud.

item.title: Moraes nega redução de pena de Débora do Batom enquanto lei da dosimetria não é promulgada
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes denied the defense's request to reduce the sentence of Débora Rodrigues dos Santos, known as 'Débora do batom', based on the new penal dosimetry law. He ruled that although Congress overturned the presidential veto on the Dosimetry Bill, the law has not yet been promulgated or published, so it is not in force and cannot be applied retroactively. Débora is serving house arrest with an electronic ankle monitor and became known for writing 'Perdeu, mané' in lipstick on the statue of Justice in front of the STF in Brasília.

item.title: Páginas petistas criam versão de esquerda da ‘Dona Maria’, feita por IA
item.description: Pro-Lula pages created AI-generated Black women characters, resembling the original 'Dona Maria', to defend the government and criticize Bolsonaro and his son Flávio, focusing on ending the 6×1 work schedule and fuel price policies. The videos, posted on profiles like 'Lula pela Verdade', are labeled as AI-generated and target Black women as a key left-leaning electorate.

item.title: Moraes freia tentativa de Débora do Batom de rever pena com dosimetria
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes dismissed the defense's request for sentence reduction for Débora do Batom based on the dosimetry law, as the legislation approved by Congress has not yet been promulgated or published. Débora, sentenced to 14 years for vandalizing the Statue of Justice, is serving time under house arrest with an electronic ankle monitor. The promulgation of the veto override depends on President Lula, or if he fails to act, on Senate President Davi Alcolumbre.

item.title: A expectativa de Alckmin para o novo encontro entre Lula e Trump
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin expressed hope that the upcoming meeting between President Lula and Donald Trump will strengthen Brazil-U.S. relations through dialogue, emphasizing the importance of American investments in Brazil. He noted the meeting should discuss topics such as big tech regulation, rare earths, strategic minerals, and reducing non-tariff barriers, calling the U.S. Brazil’s top foreign investor and a key partner for mutual gain.

item.title: Presidente do DC afirma que barrou Wilson Witzel por já ter ‘doidos demais’ no partido
item.description: The president of the Christian Democracy (DC) party, João Caldas, said he blocked the affiliation of former Rio governor Wilson Witzel due to the party already having 'too many crazies.' Witzel denied the claim, stating the initiative came from DC presidential pre-candidate Aldo Rebelo and that he has been affiliated with the Democrata party since 2022, running as a pre-candidate for Rio governor. His five-year ineligibility, stemming from a 2021 impeachment over pandemic-related health contract irregularities, ends before August 15, making him eligible to run in this year's election.

item.title: Após cirurgia no ombro direito, ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro recebe alta
item.description: Former president Jair Bolsonaro was discharged from the hospital on Monday, April 4, following an arthroscopic rotator cuff repair surgery on his right shoulder, performed without complications on April 1. Bolsonaro remains under house arrest since March 24 due to a 27-year-and-3-month prison sentence, and the surgery was approved by the Supreme Court after his defense requested authorization for the full treatment process, including rehabilitation. The procedure addressed an injury to the rotator cuff, a critical structure for shoulder movement and stability.

item.title: Queda de Messias gera onda de pretendentes em busca de nova indicação de Lula ao STF
item.description: The Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias as Lula's STF nominee has triggered a race among approximately twenty potential candidates, drawn from former ministers, STJ and TCU judges, criminal lawyers, popular movements, and congressional politicians. The strategy involves floating 'trial balloons' to pressure Lula into nominating someone who also gains Senate approval, avoiding another defeat. Lula faces pressure not to yield to Alcolumbre but is also advised to avoid direct confrontation with the Senate president, amid internal PT divisions between moderates and factions advocating confrontation.

item.title: Mirar o STF em meio a uma crise geral de confiança é miopia deliberada, diz Gilmar
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes warned that focusing solely on the Judiciary to address Brazil's widespread crisis of institutional trust is 'deliberate myopia', stating that the Banco Master scandal provoked public bewilderment and outrage. He advocated for a 'New Republican Pact' encompassing parliamentary amendment rationalization, electoral reform—especially the proportional model—CPI discipline, transparency in power exercise, and review of distortions in public service remuneration.

item.title: Alckmin espera diálogo e “boa química” em encontro entre Lula e Trump
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin expressed hope that the upcoming meeting between Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and U.S. President Donald Trump would be guided by dialogue and the 'good chemistry' between the two leaders, strengthening bilateral relations. He emphasized that the United States is Brazil's top investor and that the meeting should discuss big tech, rare earths, and reciprocal investments, while also commenting on the new Desenrola debt renegotiation program for those earning up to five minimum wages.

item.title: O novo encontro entre Lula e Messias
item.description: Jorge Messias is set to have a new meeting with President Lula today or tomorrow to determine his future in government. Although there are speculations about his possible departure from the Ministry of Justice or the AGU, the most likely outcome is that he remains in his current position. Recent talks include an in-person meeting last Wednesday after his STF nomination was rejected by the Senate, and a phone call over the weekend.

item.title: O veto a bets no Novo Desenrola, prioridade de Lula para aliviar a inadimplência
item.description: President Lula instituted the Novo Desenrola program via provisional measure, with a 90-day duration, to renegotiate debts of delinquent Brazilians. A key condition of the program is a one-year ban on online betting (bets), even after CPF unblocking, to prevent newly available funds from being spent on gambling and worsening financial instability. The program includes four pillars: Families, Fies, Businesses, and Rural, offering up to 90% debt discounts, reduced interest rates, and FGTS usage for debt settlement.

item.title: Lula lança nova fase do Desenrola com desconto de até 90% em dívida
item.description: President Lula announced on Monday (4) a new phase of the Desenrola program, offering discounts of up to 90% on Brazilian citizens' debts with financial institutions. The measure, formalized through a provisional measure, takes effect next Tuesday (5) and will last 90 days, aiming to alleviate household indebtedness.
